prerequisites.zh: 应用真实代码将可控值赋给 location、href、assign 或 replace，且能够区分赋值来源、目标 scheme 与浏览器导航策略。
prerequisites.en: Real application code assigns a controllable value to location, href, assign, or replace, with assignment source, destination scheme, and browser navigation policy distinguishable.

prerequisites.zh: 导航 API 已加只读跟踪，普通 HTTPS 跳转使用自有空页面，javascript 分支仅设置一次性 marker，并保护测试页面状态。
prerequisites.en: Navigation APIs have read-only tracing, ordinary HTTPS redirects use an owned empty page, javascript branches set only a one-time marker, and test-page state is protected.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是受控 javascript scheme 经应用赋值后在当前文档来源执行 marker；若只导航到 HTTPS 目标，应单独归类开放重定向。 假阳性边界：href 字符串显示、浏览器阻止活动 scheme、用户在地址栏手工执行、只发生普通跨源跳转或 CSP 告警都不是 location XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the controlled javascript scheme to execute the marker in the current document origin after application assignment; navigation only to an HTTPS target is classified separately as open redirect. False-positive boundary: Displayed href text, browser blocking of an active scheme, manual address-bar execution, ordinary cross-origin navigation, or a CSP alert is not location-based XSS.

opsecTips.zh: Location 测试启用导航拦截并限制一次；出现历史循环、页面卸载、真实业务状态丢失、下载或非测试域跳转时停止。
opsecTips.en: Location testing intercepts navigation and permits one attempt; stop on history loops, page unload, loss of real business state, downloads, or navigation to a non-test domain.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复导航 API、原始 URL、history 与路由状态，关闭自有目标页，清理 BFCache/站点数据并重新进入测试流程。
opsecTips.en: Restore navigation APIs, the original URL, history, and routing state, close the owned target page, clear BFCache and site data, and re-enter the test flow.

title.zh: replace 导航
title.en: replace navigation

description.zh: 绕过 location= 赋值特征：replace 方法形态。判据：二次导航执行。
description.en: Uses replace() instead of assignment. Success: second navigation executes.

title.zh: assign 解码导航
title.en: assign with decoded target

description.zh: 绕过 javascript: 明文：base64 解码后导航。判据：执行弹窗。
description.en: Decodes the target at runtime. Success: alert fires.

title.zh: href 实体赋值
title.en: href entity assignment

description.zh: 绕过嵌套 javascript: 匹配：内层实体化。判据：解码执行。
description.en: Entity-encodes the inner scheme. Success: executes after decoding.

title.zh: document.location 变体
title.en: document.location variant

description.zh: 绕过 location= 单形态规则：document 前缀加 confirm 输出。判据：显示域名确认框。
description.en: document-prefixed assignment with confirm output. Success: domain shown.

name.zh: JavaScript 标识符混淆变体

description.zh: 使用 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接和 Function 构造等方式重建调用，验证只识别危险关键字的过滤策略是否可绕过。
description.en: Reconstructs calls through String.fromCharCode, concatenation, and Function construction to test filters that recognize only dangerous keywords.

overview.zh: 覆盖 JavaScript 词法混淆变体的验证：String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接、括号索引、逗号求值、atob 与 Function 构造在运行时重建调用。用于确认只识别危险关键字的过滤策略是否可绕过。
overview.en: Covers JavaScript lexical-obfuscation variants: String.fromCharCode, string concatenation, bracket indexing, comma evaluation, atob, and Function construction rebuilding calls at runtime. Used to test whether filters recognizing only dangerous keywords can be bypassed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入汇；运行时重建的函数名与参数绕过静态字符串规则。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the attacker already controlling a JavaScript execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal keywords like alert and eval without eliminating code-injection sinks; runtime-rebuilt function names and arguments bypass static string rules.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行以 fromCharCode、字符串拼接、括号索引、逗号求值、atob 等混淆构造执行；执行即确认词法混淆可绕过标识符检测，SVG 行外发 cookie 到 {ATTACKER_HOST} 作为外带验证。在确认可执行的汇中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换编码形态，定位产生差异的词法规则。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to execute via fromCharCode, string concatenation, bracket indexing, comma evaluation, atob, and similar obfuscation line by line; execution confirms lexical obfuscation bypasses identifier detection, with the SVG line exfiltrating cookies to {ATTACKER_HOST} as out-of-band proof. Inside a confirmed-executable sink, test direct calls first, then swap encodings one by one to locate which lexical rule makes the difference.

mitigation.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单。修复后混淆表达式的运行时值与调用目标应无法还原为有效执行。
mitigation.en: Remove user-controllable code contexts at the root, adopting fixed call maps and data serialization; neither server nor frontend should rely on dangerous-function-name blacklists. After the fix, obfuscated expressions must be unable to resolve into valid execution at runtime.

title.zh: 固定“JavaScript 标识符混淆变体”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入 sink”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the attacker already controls a JavaScript execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal tokens such as alert or eval instead of removing the code-injection sink, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“JavaScript 词法混淆”多层基线
title.en: Establish the JavaScript Lexical Obfuscation baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“JavaScript 标识符混淆变体”
title.en: Run a single-variable JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants check

description.zh: 在确认可执行的 sink 中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换字符编码、属性拼接和 Function 构造，定位是哪一种词法规则产生差异；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: in a confirmed executable sink, test a direct call first and then substitute character encoding, property concatenation, and Function construction one at a time to locate the differing rule; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the JavaScript Identifier Obfuscation Variants remediation boundary

description.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability no longer appears.

review.rationale: JavaScript 标识符混淆变体保留为 Payload，用于审查“运行时重建的函数名和参数是否绕过静态字符串规则，同时保持与直接调用相同的执行语义”。成立时必须满足证据要求“混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 目标防护主要依赖危险标识符黑名单，可控表达式在过滤后仍进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文或动态求值 sink。
prerequisites.en: The target defense relies mainly on dangerous-identifier blacklisting, and the controlled expression still reaches executable JavaScript or a dynamic-evaluation sink after filtering.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接或 Function 构造前后的源码值，marker 仅修改隔离页面中的固定布尔标志。
prerequisites.en: Source values before and after String.fromCharCode, string concatenation, or Function construction are recorded, and the marker only changes a fixed Boolean in the isolated page.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是混淆表达式通过目标过滤，运行时重建危险调用并执行 marker，且反混淆值、执行 sink 与来源能连续关联。 假阳性边界：过滤器未告警、字符串成功拼接、反混淆工具得到 alert 文本、CSP 阻断或表达式只作为数据显示均不是执行证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the obfuscated expression to pass the target filter, reconstruct the dangerous call at runtime, and execute the marker, continuously correlating deobfuscated value, execution sink, and source. False-positive boundary: No filter alert, successful string concatenation, an alert string produced by a deobfuscator, CSP blocking, or display as data is not execution evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 标识符混淆验证不得重建 cookie、storage、网络或系统 API；发现动态导入、外连、全局原型修改或循环执行时停止。
opsecTips.en: Identifier-obfuscation validation must not reconstruct cookie, storage, network, or system APIs; stop on dynamic imports, egress, global prototype changes, or execution loops.

opsecTips.zh: 删除混淆脚本和 marker 变量，恢复全局对象/原型，清理脚本缓存并重载页面后用普通 JavaScript 业务路径回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete obfuscated scripts and marker variables, restore global objects and prototypes, clear script caches, reload, and regress normal JavaScript business paths.

title.zh: atob 解码求值
title.en: atob-decoded evaluation

description.zh: 绕过字母级规则：base64 还原。判据：弹窗。
description.en: Base64 restore. Success: alert.

title.zh: unescape 百分号解码
title.en: unescape percent-decoding

description.zh: 绕过 fromCharCode 特征：百分号编码路径。判据：执行。
description.en: Percent-encoding path instead of char codes. Success: executes.

title.zh: 字符串拼接调用
title.en: Concatenated invocation

description.zh: 绕过 alert 整词匹配：拼接属性访问。判据：弹窗。
description.en: Splits the function name when joining the property key. Success: alert.

title.zh: 作用域对象构造调用
title.en: Scope-object constructed call

description.zh: 绕过引号形态检测：字符码构造方法名。判据：执行成功。
description.en: Builds the method name from char codes. Success: executes.

name.zh: Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集

description.zh: 该记录是从 Awesome-WAF 汇总的多种编码和解析差异字典，适合作为 XSS 工具的自定义 Payload 输入，而非独立漏洞类型。
description.en: This record is a multi-encoding and parser-differential dictionary collected from Awesome-WAF and belongs as custom payload input for XSS tools rather than a separate vulnerability type.

overview.zh: Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集是来源型 XSS 字典，不代表独立漏洞数据流。维护重点为：字典条目如何按编码、空白、空字节和标签解析特征去重并供 Dalfox、XSStrike 等工具按上下文选择。它的适用边界为：该内容本身不描述可触发的应用数据流，只有在具体输入点、输出上下文与浏览器执行证据同时存在时才可能证明 XSS。任何具体漏洞都必须补充以下证据：迁移后保留原始命令字节和来源引用，并以工具运行记录关联具体目标上下文，不能用字典命中数替代漏洞证据。
overview.en: Awesome-WAF XSS Dictionary Command Set checks how dictionary entries are deduplicated by encoding, whitespace, null-byte, and tag-parsing traits for context-aware use by tools such as Dalfox or XSStrike. It applies when the content does not describe an application data flow; XSS is proven only when a concrete input, output context, and browser execution evidence exist together. A conclusion requires the migration preserves original command bytes and provenance while tool runs link each match to a concrete target context; dictionary hit counts are not vulnerability evidence; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 字典本身不是漏洞。只有满足“该内容本身不描述可触发的应用数据流，只有在具体输入点、输出上下文与浏览器执行证据同时存在时才可能证明 XSS”时，样例才可用于审查“字典条目如何按编码、空白、空字节和标签解析特征去重并供 Dalfox、XSStrike 等工具按上下文选择”。工具命中、字符串反射或上游仓库收录都只是候选信号；缺少“迁移后保留原始命令字节和来源引用，并以工具运行记录关联具体目标上下文，不能用字典命中数替代漏洞证据”时不能形成 XSS 结论。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the content does not describe an application data flow; XSS is proven only when a concrete input, output context, and browser execution evidence exist together, allowing how dictionary entries are deduplicated by encoding, whitespace, null-byte, and tag-parsing traits for context-aware use by tools such as Dalfox or XSStrike. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the migration preserves original command bytes and provenance while tool runs link each match to a concrete target context; dictionary hit counts are not vulnerability evidence; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 把原集合按行导入 XSS 工具命令区，先去除完全重复项，再为每个候选记录 HTML、属性、URL 或 JavaScript 上下文和最小复现结果。迁移时保持原始字节和来源引用，按 HTML、属性、URL、JavaScript 及浏览器兼容性标注每行；工具扫描只负责发现候选，最终结果必须在隔离浏览器中缩减为可解释的最小复现。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, import the original set line by line into the XSS tool command area, remove exact duplicates, and record HTML, attribute, URL, or JavaScript context plus a minimized reproduction for every candidate. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 从 Payload 导航移除该来源字典并合并到 xss-tools，保留版本与引用；应用修复仍必须按最终 sink 编码、消毒和限制危险 DOM API。工具区保存版本、适用上下文和失效标记，应用侧仍按最终 sink 实施编码、消毒与策略控制；回归分别确认字典可复制、导航不重复且正常页面功能不受影响。
mitigation.en: Remediation should remove this source dictionary from payload navigation and merge it into xss-tools with version and provenance, while application fixes still require sink-specific encoding, sanitization, and dangerous-DOM-API controls. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

title.zh: 核对“Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集”来源与版本
title.en: Verify Awesome-WAF XSS Dictionary Command Set provenance

description.zh: 确认上游仓库、浏览器适用范围和许可，并围绕“字典条目如何按编码、空白、空字节和标签解析特征去重并供 Dalfox、XSStrike 等工具按上下文选择”建立维护标签。
description.en: Confirm the upstream repository, sample provenance, and supported browsers, documenting how dictionary entries are deduplicated by encoding, whitespace, null-byte, and tag-parsing traits for context-aware use by tools such as Dalfox or XSStrike without treating upstream inclusion as vulnerability proof.

title.zh: 标注“XSS 工具字典”适用上下文
title.en: Tag XSS Tool Dictionary contexts

description.zh: 按元素、属性、URL、JavaScript 和交互条件标记每行；适用边界为“该内容本身不描述可触发的应用数据流，只有在具体输入点、输出上下文与浏览器执行证据同时存在时才可能证明 XSS”。
description.en: Tag each line by HTML, attribute, URL, JavaScript, event, and compatibility context; test a target only when the content does not describe an application data flow; XSS is proven only when a concrete input, output context, and browser execution evidence exist together.

title.zh: 迁移“Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集”原始命令
title.en: Migrate the original Awesome-WAF XSS Dictionary Command Set bytes

description.zh: 把原集合完整移入 xss-tools，保留引用并精确去重；具体命中仍须满足“迁移后保留原始命令字节和来源引用，并以工具运行记录关联具体目标上下文，不能用字典命中数替代漏洞证据”。
description.en: Move the complete original command set into xss-tools, preserve provenance, and deduplicate exact bytes; every concrete hit still requires the migration preserves original command bytes and provenance while tool runs link each match to a concrete target context; dictionary hit counts are not vulnerability evidence.

attackChain.payload: %E2%88%80%E3%B8%80%E3%B0%80script%E3%B8%80alert(1)%E3%B0%80/script%E3%B8%80 alert(1); alert(1); confirm(0); pwn3d

title.zh: 建立“Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集”工具回归
title.en: Create Awesome-WAF XSS Dictionary Command Set tool regression

description.zh: 从 Payload 导航移除该来源字典并合并到 xss-tools，保留版本与引用；应用修复仍必须按最终 sink 编码、消毒和限制危险 DOM API；确认工具入口可复制原命令、失效项有标记，且 Payload 导航不再重复展示来源字典。
description.en: Validate retained samples against fixed isolated pages, mark obsolete entries, remove duplicate payload navigation, and confirm the tool entry still copies the original command.

review.rationale: Awesome-WAF XSS 字典命令集是来源型 XSS 字典，不描述独立应用数据流。其维护目标是“字典条目如何按编码、空白、空字节和标签解析特征去重并供 Dalfox、XSStrike 等工具按上下文选择”，因此由现有 xss-tools 保存原始命令、版本、适用上下文和出处。

prerequisites.zh: Awesome-WAF 来源、许可和原始字节已记录，目标 XSS 工具支持按 HTML/属性/URL/脚本上下文标记，而非把整表当一个漏洞。
prerequisites.en: Awesome-WAF provenance, license, and original bytes are recorded, and the destination XSS tool supports HTML, attribute, URL, and script context tags rather than treating the corpus as one vulnerability.

prerequisites.zh: 可在离线 parser harness 与明确浏览器矩阵中逐行解码，记录有效、失效、仅签名和版本限定状态。
prerequisites.en: Each line can be decoded in an offline parser harness and explicit browser matrix, with valid, invalid, signature-only, and version-limited states recorded.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是字典迁移后原字节与来源完整、上下文标签准确，某候选在隔离目标 sink 中用 marker 独立验证；迁移成功不等于目标存在 XSS。 假阳性边界：字典含危险字符串、WAF 放行某行、离线 parser 识别标签或公共 payload 在其他网站有效，都不能证明当前应用漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive evidence means migrated bytes and provenance remain intact, context tags are accurate, and a candidate is independently validated with a marker in an isolated target sink; successful migration does not mean a target has XSS. False-positive boundary: Dangerous strings in the corpus, WAF allowance, an offline parser recognizing a tag, or a public payload working elsewhere does not prove a vulnerability in the current application.

opsecTips.zh: Awesome-WAF 字典默认只离线整理，禁止整表对站点批量发送；出现真实扫描流量、公共目标或非 marker 副作用时停止。
opsecTips.en: The Awesome-WAF corpus is organized offline by default and never bulk-sent to a site; stop on real scan traffic, public targets, or effects beyond a marker.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时解码文件、浏览器 profile 和执行结果，合并重复项但保留来源哈希，并确认目标工具没有未标记的失效行。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary decoded files, browser profiles, and execution results, merge duplicates while retaining source hashes, and confirm the destination tool has no untagged invalid line.

name.zh: AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异
name.en: AWS WAF and CloudFront XSS Normalization Differential

description.zh: 以 CRLF、引号闭合和 URL 编码 SVG 等小型样例验证 CloudFront 前置 AWS WAF 与源站、浏览器之间的规范化差异。
description.en: Uses compact CRLF, quote-closure, and URL-encoded SVG samples to compare normalization across CloudFront, AWS WAF, the origin, and the browser.

overview.zh: 覆盖 AWS WAF/CloudFront 与源站、浏览器之间的规范化差异测试：以 CRLF、引号闭合和 URL 编码 SVG 等小型探针对比放行差异。用于确认 Web ACL 转换顺序与源站解码链是否一致。
overview.en: Covers normalization-differential testing across AWS WAF/CloudFront, origin, and browser: small probes with CRLF, quote closure, and URL-encoded SVG comparing pass-through differences. Used to confirm whether Web ACL transformation order matches the origin decode chain.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Web ACL 的转换顺序或匹配范围与源站解码链不一致，且应用最终把参数放入可执行 HTML 上下文；边缘放行的字节序列在源站解码后恢复为可执行标记。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Web ACL transformation order or matching scope diverging from the origin decode chain while the application ultimately places parameters into executable HTML contexts; byte sequences passed at the edge revert to executable markup after origin decoding.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交 4 条 CloudFront/AWS WAF 规范化探针；直连放行且执行作为基线，叠加 CloudFront 后对比放行差异即可判断规范化差异。在测试 Web ACL 中逐项记录 URL_DECODE、HTML_ENTITY_DECODE 等转换顺序，分别提交原始和单层编码样例并对比源站日志与浏览器 DOM。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit four CloudFront/AWS WAF normalization probes; direct access passing and executing is the baseline, and comparing pass differences once CloudFront is layered in reveals normalization differentials. mitigation.en: Align edge and origin on a single-pass normalization model, use AWS managed rules with precise scope, and apply context encoding and sanitization at the application's final HTML sinks; after the fix, all three layers (edge, origin, browser) must agree for the same request.

description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier as valid evidence.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the AWS WAF and CloudFront XSS Normalization Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 让边缘与源站采用一致的单次规范化模型，使用 AWS 托管规则与精确作用域，并在应用最终 HTML sink 执行上下文编码和消毒；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier no longer appears.

review.rationale: AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异保留为 Payload，用于审查“CloudFront、AWS WAF 文本转换、源站框架和浏览器对 CRLF、URL 编码与属性闭合是否得到不同字节序列”。成立时必须满足证据要求“同一请求的边缘动作日志、源站接收值、响应 DOM 与唯一执行标记可以通过请求 ID 关联”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 请求通过目标 CloudFront distribution 与 AWS WAF Web ACL 到达自有源站，规则组、转换和缓存键配置均可核验。
prerequisites.en: Requests traverse the target CloudFront distribution and AWS WAF web ACL to an owned origin, with rule groups, transformations, and cache-key configuration verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 边缘日志、源站原始值/规范值、响应字节和浏览器 DOM 使用同一请求 ID，并有被阻断危险基线与普通输入基线。
prerequisites.en: Edge logs, origin raw and canonical values, response bytes, and browser DOM share one request identifier, with a blocked-dangerous baseline and benign-input baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某规范化变体穿过实际 AWS WAF/CloudFront 路径，源站将其输出为活动上下文，浏览器随后执行 marker；三层证据缺一不可。 假阳性边界：边缘返回 200、只绕过单条规则、直接源站请求、缓存旧响应、源站编码输入或浏览器不执行均不是完整 XSS 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a normalization variant to pass the real AWS WAF and CloudFront path, be emitted by the origin into an active context, and execute the browser marker; evidence from all three layers is required. False-positive boundary: An edge HTTP 200, bypass of one rule only, direct-origin access, a cached old response, origin encoding, or no browser execution is not a complete XSS bypass.

opsecTips.zh: AWS WAF 差异验证只在专用路径和低速率进行；发现生产缓存命中、真实用户请求、规则自动更新或源站压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: AWS WAF differential validation uses a dedicated path at low rate; stop on production cache hits, real-user requests, automatic rule updates, or origin pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试规则/日志增强，失效专用 CloudFront 缓存对象，删除源站测试记录和浏览器 marker，并重放边缘基线。
opsecTips.en: Revert test rules and enhanced logging, invalidate dedicated CloudFront cache objects, delete origin test records and browser markers, and replay edge baselines.

name.zh: Tricks-Web-Pentest XSS 字典

description.zh: 该条目是外部项目收集的事件属性、SVG 与模板字面量变体，应迁入 XSS 工具字典并按上下文索引，而不是占用一个漏洞 Payload 节点。
description.en: This entry is an external collection of event-attribute, SVG, and template-literal variants that belongs in a context-indexed XSS tool dictionary rather than a vulnerability payload node.

overview.zh: Tricks-Web-Pentest XSS 字典是来源型 XSS 字典，不代表独立漏洞数据流。维护重点为：外部样例如何保留来源并按属性闭合、自动事件、交互事件和 JavaScript 语法分类，避免与基础集合重复。它的适用边界为：字典中的任意字符串只有在目标应用提供匹配的输出上下文和危险 sink 时才有意义，脱离数据流不能称为攻击链。任何具体漏洞都必须补充以下证据：工具卡中保存原集合、上游仓库引用与上下文标签，具体漏洞报告仍需提供最小请求、最终 DOM 和执行标记。
overview.en: Tricks-Web-Pentest XSS Dictionary checks how external samples retain provenance and are classified by attribute closure, automatic events, interaction events, and JavaScript syntax without duplicating the basic set. It applies when a dictionary string matters only when the target exposes a matching output context and dangerous sink; without a data flow it is not an attack chain. A conclusion requires the tool card preserves the original set, upstream repository reference, and context tags, while any vulnerability report still provides a minimal request, final DOM, and execution marker; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 字典本身不是漏洞。只有满足“字典中的任意字符串只有在目标应用提供匹配的输出上下文和危险 sink 时才有意义，脱离数据流不能称为攻击链”时，样例才可用于审查“外部样例如何保留来源并按属性闭合、自动事件、交互事件和 JavaScript 语法分类，避免与基础集合重复”。工具命中、字符串反射或上游仓库收录都只是候选信号；缺少“工具卡中保存原集合、上游仓库引用与上下文标签，具体漏洞报告仍需提供最小请求、最终 DOM 和执行标记”时不能形成 XSS 结论。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when a dictionary string matters only when the target exposes a matching output context and dangerous sink; without a data flow it is not an attack chain, allowing how external samples retain provenance and are classified by attribute closure, automatic events, interaction events, and JavaScript syntax without duplicating the basic set. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the tool card preserves the original set, upstream repository reference, and context tags, while any vulnerability report still provides a minimal request, final DOM, and execution marker; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 导入 xss-tools 后对完全相同和语义等价的行去重，为保留项增加自动触发或交互触发标签，再通过 Dalfox 或手工浏览器对照具体 sink。迁移时保持原始字节和来源引用，按 HTML、属性、URL、JavaScript 及浏览器兼容性标注每行；工具扫描只负责发现候选，最终结果必须在隔离浏览器中缩减为可解释的最小复现。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, after import into xss-tools, deduplicate exact and semantic equivalents, tag retained lines as automatic or interaction-triggered, and validate them against a concrete sink with Dalfox or a manual browser. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 从 Payload 树移除来源型字典，统一在工具区维护版本与上下文标签；应用侧继续采用输出编码、HTML 消毒和严格 CSP。工具区保存版本、适用上下文和失效标记，应用侧仍按最终 sink 实施编码、消毒与策略控制；回归分别确认字典可复制、导航不重复且正常页面功能不受影响。
mitigation.en: Remediation should remove the source dictionary from the payload tree, maintain versions and context tags in the tool area, and keep application controls based on output encoding, HTML sanitization, and strict CSP. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

review.rationale: Tricks-Web-Pentest XSS 字典是来源型 XSS 字典，不描述独立应用数据流。其维护目标是“外部样例如何保留来源并按属性闭合、自动事件、交互事件和 JavaScript 语法分类，避免与基础集合重复”，因此由现有 xss-tools 保存原始命令、版本、适用上下文和出处。

prerequisites.zh: 外部 Tricks-Web-Pentest 条目的来源和许可可追溯，目标工具能够按事件属性、SVG 与模板字面量等上下文索引。
prerequisites.en: The external Tricks-Web-Pentest entries have traceable provenance and licensing, and the destination tool indexes event attributes, SVG, and template literals by context.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是迁移条目保持原字节和来源、被放入正确上下文，并在对应 fixture 中由预期事件执行 marker；这只是工具质量验证。 假阳性边界：外部项目收录、字符串含 on*、浏览器 parser 接受标签、WAF 告警或其他目标上的历史成功都不能证明当前应用 XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires migrated entries to retain bytes and provenance, be placed in the correct context, and execute a marker through the expected event in the matching fixture; this validates tool quality only. False-positive boundary: Inclusion in an external project, an on* substring, browser parser acceptance, a WAF alert, or historical success on another target does not prove XSS in the current application.

opsecTips.zh: Tricks-Web-Pentest 字典只在离线/fixture 中运行，禁止批量投递到真实站点；出现弹窗之外副作用、外连或用户交互时停止。
opsecTips.en: The Tricks-Web-Pentest corpus runs only offline or in fixtures and is never bulk-delivered to a real site; stop on effects beyond the marker, egress, or user interaction.

description.en: This source collection mixes media events, dialog, blob or data modules, and modern element syntax and is best maintained as a browser-compatibility dictionary for XSS tooling.

subCategory.zh: 高级 XSS 工具字典

overview.zh: Advanced-XSS 浏览器特性字典是来源型 XSS 字典，不代表独立漏洞数据流。维护重点为：各样例依赖的浏览器特性、用户手势、MIME、模块策略和 CSP 条件如何标注，以避免把已废弃语法当作通用 Payload。它的适用边界为：只有目标浏览器支持对应元素或事件、应用输出位置匹配且策略允许活动内容时，字典条目才可能形成执行。任何具体漏洞都必须补充以下证据：每个保留样例记录浏览器版本、最终 DOM、控制台策略结果和唯一执行标记，上游列表本身不构成有效性证明。
overview.en: Advanced-XSS Browser Feature Dictionary checks how browser features, user gestures, MIME handling, module policy, and CSP prerequisites are tagged so obsolete syntax is not presented as a universal payload. It applies when a dictionary entry can execute only when the target browser supports the element or event, the output context matches, and policy permits the active content. A conclusion requires every retained sample records browser version, final DOM, policy diagnostics, and a unique execution marker; inclusion upstream is not proof of validity; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 字典本身不是漏洞。只有满足“只有目标浏览器支持对应元素或事件、应用输出位置匹配且策略允许活动内容时，字典条目才可能形成执行”时，样例才可用于审查“各样例依赖的浏览器特性、用户手势、MIME、模块策略和 CSP 条件如何标注，以避免把已废弃语法当作通用 Payload”。工具命中、字符串反射或上游仓库收录都只是候选信号；缺少“每个保留样例记录浏览器版本、最终 DOM、控制台策略结果和唯一执行标记，上游列表本身不构成有效性证明”时不能形成 XSS 结论。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when a dictionary entry can execute only when the target browser supports the element or event, the output context matches, and policy permits the active content, allowing how browser features, user gestures, MIME handling, module policy, and CSP prerequisites are tagged so obsolete syntax is not presented as a universal payload. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and every retained sample records browser version, final DOM, policy diagnostics, and a unique execution marker; inclusion upstream is not proof of validity; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 迁入 xss-tools 后按媒体、对话框、模块和 blob/data 文档分组，在支持矩阵中逐条验证，并将已废弃或无效项标记而非静默删除。迁移时保持原始字节和来源引用，按 HTML、属性、URL、JavaScript 及浏览器兼容性标注每行；工具扫描只负责发现候选，最终结果必须在隔离浏览器中缩减为可解释的最小复现。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, after migration to xss-tools, group samples by media, dialog, module, and blob or data document, validate them against a support matrix, and mark obsolete or invalid entries rather than silently deleting them. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 工具区保留来源和兼容性说明，Payload 树只展示已确认的数据流技术；应用修复应限制活动元素、外部资源、模块加载与危险 DOM sink。工具区保存版本、适用上下文和失效标记，应用侧仍按最终 sink 实施编码、消毒与策略控制；回归分别确认字典可复制、导航不重复且正常页面功能不受影响。
mitigation.en: Remediation should keep provenance and compatibility notes in tools while payload navigation presents confirmed data-flow techniques; applications should restrict active elements, external resources, module loading, and dangerous DOM sinks. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

title.zh: 建立“Advanced-XSS 浏览器特性字典”工具回归
title.en: Create Advanced-XSS Browser Feature Dictionary tool regression

description.zh: 工具区保留来源和兼容性说明，Payload 树只展示已确认的数据流技术；应用修复应限制活动元素、外部资源、模块加载与危险 DOM sink；确认工具入口可复制原命令、失效项有标记，且 Payload 导航不再重复展示来源字典。
description.en: Validate retained samples against fixed isolated pages, mark obsolete entries, remove duplicate payload navigation, and confirm the tool entry still copies the original command.

review.rationale: Advanced-XSS 浏览器特性字典是来源型 XSS 字典，不描述独立应用数据流。其维护目标是“各样例依赖的浏览器特性、用户手势、MIME、模块策略和 CSP 条件如何标注，以避免把已废弃语法当作通用 Payload”，因此由现有 xss-tools 保存原始命令、版本、适用上下文和出处。

prerequisites.zh: Advanced-XSS 来源集合的许可、浏览器版本和特性依赖已记录，条目按媒体事件、dialog、blob/data module 等能力分组。
prerequisites.en: Licensing, browser versions, and feature dependencies for the Advanced-XSS source are recorded, with entries grouped by media events, dialog, blob or data modules, and related capabilities.

prerequisites.zh: 每个候选只在支持该特性的隔离浏览器 fixture 中使用固定 marker，资源和 module URL 均指向本地测试端点。
prerequisites.en: Each candidate uses a fixed marker only in an isolated browser fixture supporting the feature, with resources and module URLs pointing to local test endpoints.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是工具项的特性标签和版本前提正确，目标 fixture 触发预期事件或模块处理并执行 marker；结果不自动映射到任意应用。 假阳性边界：现代浏览器已移除特性、parser 仅创建惰性节点、资源请求没有事件、字符串可复制或旧 PoC 文档存在均不是有效执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires correct feature tags and version prerequisites, with the target fixture triggering the expected event or module processing and executing the marker; results do not automatically transfer to an application. False-positive boundary: A feature removed by modern browsers, an inert parser node, a resource request without its event, a copyable string, or old proof-of-concept documentation is not valid execution.

opsecTips.zh: 高级浏览器特性字典不得创建真实 blob 下载、外部 module 或持续媒体；出现权限提示、下载、摄像头/麦克风请求或外连时停止。
opsecTips.en: The advanced browser-feature corpus must not create real blob downloads, external modules, or persistent media; stop on permission prompts, downloads, camera or microphone access, or egress.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 blob/object URL，停止媒体和 module worker，删除 fixture/profile 与缓存，并给不再支持的行保留明确失效标签。
opsecTips.en: Revoke blob and object URLs, stop media and module workers, delete fixtures, profiles, and caches, and retain explicit invalid labels for unsupported lines.

name.zh: 结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合

description.zh: 聚焦 title、style、textarea、script、属性和 MathML/SVG 等嵌套结构闭合，验证复杂输出位置中的 HTML tokenizer 状态转换。
description.en: Focuses on closing title, style, textarea, script, attribute, MathML, and SVG structures to test HTML tokenizer state transitions in complex output locations.

overview.zh: 覆盖结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 的 tokenizer 状态突破验证：title、style、textarea、script、属性与 MathML/SVG 嵌套结构的闭合序列。用于确认复杂输出位置中 tokenizer 能否切换到可创建事件节点的状态。
overview.en: Covers tokenizer state-breakout verification with structurally closed XSS Polyglots: closure sequences across title, style, textarea, script, attributes, and MathML/SVG nesting. Used to confirm whether the tokenizer can switch to states that create event nodes in complex output positions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码拼接；组合闭合序列把 tokenizer 从 RCDATA、RAWTEXT、属性值或外来内容状态切出。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted values landing inside opaque nested templates with only plain HTML text encoded, or intermediate components re-decoding and re-concatenating encoded results; combined closure sequences switch the tokenizer out of RCDATA, RAWTEXT, attribute-value, or foreign-content states.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交结构闭合型 Polyglot（含 MathML/mglyph 分支与模块脚本形态）；任一上下文突破执行即确认对应 Tokenizer 状态可达。先确认当前元素和属性状态再提交；对命中项逐段删除前缀和后缀，直到得到能解释状态转换的最小样例。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit structurally closed Polyglots line by line (including MathML/mglyph branches and module-script forms); breakout execution in any context confirms the corresponding tokenizer state is reachable. Confirm the current element and attribute state before submitting; on hits, strip prefixes and suffixes segment by segment until a minimal sample explaining the state transition remains.

mitigation.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types；修复后各闭合序列应停留在原解析状态，无事件节点生成。
mitigation.en: Let the template engine auto-escape in the final context, forbid component re-decoding, and apply namespace-aware sanitizers with Trusted Types for rich HTML; after the fix, closure sequences must remain in their original parse states with no event nodes created.

title.zh: 定位“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码和拼接”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that untrusted data lands in an opaque nested template where only ordinary HTML-text encoding is applied or an intermediate component decodes and concatenates the value again, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“HTML Tokenizer 状态突破”解析基线
title.en: Establish the HTML Tokenizer State Breakout baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“解析器状态对应的最小闭合前缀、生成节点和执行事件均可从最终 DOM 解释，避免保留无法说明原因的超长字符串”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set check

description.zh: 先确认当前元素和属性状态，再提交原 Polyglot；对命中项逐段删除前缀和后缀，直到得到能解释 tokenizer 转换的最小样例；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: identify the current element and attribute state before submitting the original polyglot, then delete prefixes and suffixes from a hit until the tokenizer transition has a minimal explainable sample; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 修复并回归“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”
title.en: Retest the Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set remediation boundary

description.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string no longer appears.

review.rationale: 结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合保留为 Payload，用于审查“组合闭合序列是否把 tokenizer 从 RCDATA、RAWTEXT、属性值或外来内容状态切换到可创建事件节点的状态”。成立时必须满足证据要求“解析器状态对应的最小闭合前缀、生成节点和执行事件均可从最终 DOM 解释，避免保留无法说明原因的超长字符串”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 已定位 title、style、textarea、script、属性或 MathML/SVG 中的确切 HTML tokenizer 状态与模板包裹字符。
prerequisites.en: The exact HTML tokenizer state and template wrapper characters are identified for title, style, textarea, script, attribute, or MathML and SVG contexts.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮从 polyglot 缩减为一个结构闭合假设，使用固定 marker，并保存响应源码、tokenizer trace 与解析后 DOM。
prerequisites.en: Each run minimizes the polyglot to one structural-breakout hypothesis, uses a fixed marker, and preserves response source, tokenizer trace, and parsed DOM.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是输入关闭目标原始 tokenizer 状态，建立活动元素或事件属性并执行 marker；必须报告具体闭合片段而非整条 polyglot。 假阳性边界：复杂字符串回显、浏览器错误恢复生成不同 DOM、部分标签被丢弃、仅在另一个上下文可执行或 WAF 放行均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the input to close the original tokenizer state, create an active element or event attribute, and execute the marker, with the exact breakout fragment reported rather than the whole polyglot. False-positive boundary: Reflection of a complex string, browser error recovery into a different inert DOM, dropped tags, execution only in another context, or WAF allowance is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 结构闭合测试每次只针对一个 tokenizer 状态；出现整个页面截断、表单结构破坏、事件循环、外连或导航时停止。
opsecTips.en: Structural-breakout testing targets one tokenizer state per run; stop on page truncation, damaged form structure, event loops, egress, or navigation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 polyglot 记录和 DOM fixture，清理模板/页面缓存，恢复原包裹结构并用合法 title/style/textarea 内容回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete polyglot records and DOM fixtures, clear template and page caches, restore original wrappers, and regress with valid title, style, and textarea content.

title.zh: 注释闭合 Polyglot
title.en: Comment-closing polyglot

description.zh: 绕过多上下文结构过滤：注释闭合全部开放标签后触发。判据：至少一处上下文执行。
description.en: Closes all open tags via comment trick then fires. Success: executes in at least one context.

title.zh: 紧凑 Polyglot
title.en: Compact polyglot

description.zh: 保留混淆核心的紧凑形态，绕过长度限制。判据：点击执行。
description.en: Compact form keeping the obfuscation core. Success: fires on click.

title.zh: 部分编码 Polyglot
title.en: Partially encoded polyglot

description.zh: 关键字符编码绕过明文规则。判据：解码后执行。
description.en: Key characters encoded. Success: executes after decoding.

title.zh: 结构突破 Polyglot
title.en: Structure-breaking polyglot

description.zh: 混合引号括号尖括号扰乱解析器状态机。判据：异常上下文仍执行。
description.en: Mixes delimiters to confuse parser state machines. Success: executes in odd contexts.

name.zh: Cloudflare WAF 通用样例对照

description.zh: 使用事件、SVG、字符引用与 MathML 等变体对照 Cloudflare 托管规则、源站解码和浏览器解析，验证真实 XSS 而非单纯放行。
description.en: Compares event, SVG, character-reference, and MathML variants across Cloudflare managed rules, origin decoding, and browser parsing to prove real XSS rather than simple acceptance.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Cloudflare 托管规则与源站、浏览器之间的 XSS 解析差异测试：11 条事件、实体编码、动态求值与 MathML 分支探针，以直连基线对比经 Cloudflare 的拦截差异。用于确认放行差异是否构成真实可执行 XSS。
overview.en: Covers XSS parsing-differential testing across Cloudflare managed rules, origin, and browser: eleven probes of events, entity encoding, dynamic evaluation, and MathML branches, comparing block differences with and without Cloudflare against a direct baseline. Used to confirm whether pass-through differences constitute real executable XSS.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Cloudflare 规则集与浏览器对混合大小写、实体编码、外来内容与事件属性的解析结果不一致，且源站把被放行值输出到可执行 HTML 上下文；规则未覆盖或跳过条件即形成缺口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Cloudflare rules and browsers parsing mixed case, entity encoding, foreign content, and event attributes differently while the origin outputs passed values into executable HTML contexts; uncovered rules or skip conditions form the gap.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交 11 条 Cloudflare 常见探针；直连放行作为基线，经 Cloudflare 复测对比拦截差异。固定规则集与浏览器版本，对每个变体记录阻断、挑战或放行动作；仅对放行项在隔离页面复核 DOM 与执行，不做高频批量探测。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit eleven common Cloudflare probes; direct-access pass-through is the baseline, and replaying through Cloudflare reveals block differences. Pin the rule set and browser version, recording block, challenge, or pass actions per variant; re-verify only pass items for DOM and execution in isolated pages, avoiding high-frequency bulk probing.

mitigation.zh: 升级并调优 Cloudflare 托管规则，删除不必要的跳过条件，源站统一解码、按上下文编码并部署严格 CSP；修复后边缘动作、源站规范化与浏览器 DOM 三层对同一请求应一致。
mitigation.en: Upgrade and tune Cloudflare managed rules, remove unnecessary skip conditions, and unify decoding, context encoding, and strict CSP at the origin; after the fix, edge actions, origin normalization, and browser DOM must agree for the same request.

title.zh: 固定“Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“规则版本或自定义跳过规则未覆盖实际参数，源站继续把被放行值输出到可执行 HTML 上下文”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the active rule version or a custom skip rule does not inspect the relevant parameter and the origin still emits the accepted value into an executable HTML context, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“Cloudflare WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Cloudflare WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“Cloudflare 安全事件、Ray ID、源站日志、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记能够逐请求关联”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential check

description.zh: 固定规则集和浏览器版本，对每个变体记录阻断、挑战或放行动作；仅对放行项在隔离页面复核 DOM 与执行，不进行高频批量探测；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: pin the ruleset and browser version, record block, challenge, or allow actions per variant, and verify DOM plus execution only for accepted cases in an isolated page without high-rate probing; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 升级并调优 Cloudflare 托管规则，删除不必要的跳过条件，同时在源站统一解码、按上下文编码并部署严格 CSP；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request no longer appears.

review.rationale: Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异保留为 Payload，用于审查“Cloudflare 规则集与浏览器对混合大小写、实体编码、外来内容和事件属性是否产生不同解析结果”。成立时必须满足证据要求“Cloudflare 安全事件、Ray ID、源站日志、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记能够逐请求关联”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 测试请求经过目标 Cloudflare zone、当前托管规则与转换后到达自有源站，且没有使用直连源站或管理员跳过规则。
prerequisites.en: Test requests traverse the target Cloudflare zone, current managed rules, and transformations to an owned origin without direct-origin access or administrator bypass.

prerequisites.zh: Cloudflare event、源站日志、响应字节和浏览器 DOM 以唯一请求令牌关联，并准备阻断与正常基线。
prerequisites.en: Cloudflare events, origin logs, response bytes, and browser DOM are correlated by a unique request token, with blocked and benign baselines prepared.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是变体穿过实际 Cloudflare 规则，源站在活动上下文输出后由浏览器执行 marker；放行、输出和执行三段必须连续。 假阳性边界：Cloudflare 返回 200/challenge、只隐藏告警、源站编码、浏览器生成惰性节点、缓存旧页面或直接源站成功都不是 WAF XSS 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a variant to pass the real Cloudflare rules, be emitted by the origin into an active context, and execute the browser marker, preserving the allow, output, and execution chain. False-positive boundary: A Cloudflare HTTP 200 or challenge, hidden alerts only, origin encoding, an inert browser node, a cached old page, or direct-origin success is not a WAF XSS bypass.

opsecTips.zh: Cloudflare 差异测试仅限专用 URL 与速率；发现生产缓存、真实访客、Bot 管理升级、规则变化或源站异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Cloudflare differential testing is limited to a dedicated URL and rate; stop on production cache involvement, real visitors, bot escalation, rule changes, or origin anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试规则/跳过项，清除专用缓存与测试页面，删除 edge/origin 调试日志和 marker，再重放正常与阻断基线。
opsecTips.en: Revert test rules and skips, purge dedicated caches and test pages, delete edge and origin debug logs plus markers, then replay benign and blocked baselines.

name.zh: Akamai App & API Protector XSS 差异
name.en: Akamai App and API Protector XSS Differential

description.zh: 针对 SVG、焦点事件和媒体错误事件等短样例，核对 Akamai 防护策略与源站 HTML 输出之间的检测差异。
description.en: Uses compact SVG, focus-event, and media-error samples to compare Akamai protection policy decisions with the origin HTML output.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Akamai App & API Protector 与源站之间的 XSS 检测差异：9 条 SVG、焦点事件与媒体错误事件短探针。用于核对策略对自动聚焦、onerror、SVG onload 等事件入口的检测是否与浏览器事件模型一致。
overview.en: Covers XSS detection differentials between Akamai App & API Protector and the origin: nine short probes of SVG, focus events, and media error events. Used to check whether policy detection of autofocus, onerror, SVG onload, and similar event entries matches the browser event model.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是生产策略处于告警模式、例外范围过宽或参数解析不完整，且源站允许事件属性进入 HTML；策略对无需交互、需焦点与依赖错误事件的触发条件覆盖不全。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is production policy in alert mode, overly broad exceptions, or incomplete parameter parsing while the origin allows event attributes into HTML; policy coverage misses interaction-free, focus-dependent, and error-event triggers.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交 9 条 Akamai 常见探针；直连放行作为基线，经 Akamai 复测对比拦截差异。逐条区分无需交互、需要焦点和依赖错误事件的触发条件，记录策略动作后在隔离浏览器复核；请求参考、策略动作、源站值与事件触发须对应同一请求。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit nine common Akamai probes; direct-access pass-through is the baseline, and replaying through Akamai reveals block differences. Separate interaction-free, focus-dependent, and error-event triggers per probe, record policy actions, then re-verify in an isolated browser; request reference, policy action, origin value, and event firing must map to the same request.

mitigation.zh: 将相关保护策略设为阻断并收紧例外与参数范围；源站移除事件属性、执行上下文编码并以 CSP 限制脚本来源；修复后三层结果一致且策略动作可追溯。
mitigation.en: Set the relevant protection policies to block and tighten exceptions and parameter scope; remove event attributes at the origin, apply context encoding, and restrict script sources via CSP; after the fix, the three layers must agree with traceable policy actions.

title.zh: 固定“Akamai App & API Protector XSS 差异”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the Akamai App and API Protector XSS Differential data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“生产策略处于告警模式、例外范围过宽或参数解析不完整，并且源站允许事件属性进入 HTML”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the production policy is in alert mode, exceptions are too broad, or parameter parsing is incomplete while the origin permits event attributes in HTML, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“Akamai WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Akamai WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“Akamai 请求参考、策略动作、源站接收值和实际事件触发标记四项信息必须对应同一请求”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the Akamai request reference, policy action, origin-received value, and actual event marker must correspond to one request as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“Akamai App & API Protector XSS 差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable Akamai App and API Protector XSS Differential check

description.zh: 在测试配置中逐条发送原样例，区分无需交互、需要焦点和依赖错误事件的触发条件，记录策略动作后才在隔离浏览器复核；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: send each original sample against a test configuration, separate automatic, focus-dependent, and error-dependent triggers, record the policy action, and only then verify in an isolated browser; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the Akamai App and API Protector XSS Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 将相关保护策略设为阻断并收紧例外和参数范围；源站应移除事件属性、执行上下文编码并以 CSP 限制脚本来源；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the Akamai request reference, policy action, origin-received value, and actual event marker must correspond to one request no longer appears.

review.rationale: Akamai App & API Protector XSS 差异保留为 Payload，用于审查“Akamai 策略对自动焦点、媒体错误和 SVG onload 等事件入口的检测是否与最终浏览器事件模型一致”。成立时必须满足证据要求“Akamai 请求参考、策略动作、源站接收值和实际事件触发标记四项信息必须对应同一请求”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 请求通过目标 Akamai property 和 App & API Protector policy 到达测试源，安全配置版本、行为链和缓存状态已固定。
prerequisites.en: Requests pass through the target Akamai property and App and API Protector policy to a test origin, with security configuration version, behavior chain, and cache state fixed.

prerequisites.zh: Akamai security event、源站收到值、HTML 输出和目标浏览器事件调用栈使用同一测试令牌，并有规则阻断对照。
prerequisites.en: Akamai security events, origin-received values, HTML output, and target-browser event call stacks share one test token, with a rule-blocked control.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是短 SVG/焦点/媒体事件变体绕过当前 Akamai policy，源站未安全编码并由对应浏览器事件执行 marker。 假阳性边界：安全事件未生成、请求获准、源站返回错误、事件属性存在但不触发、不同 Akamai 配置或直连源站结果均不能证明绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a short SVG, focus, or media-event variant to pass the current Akamai policy, remain unencoded at the origin, and execute the marker through the corresponding browser event. False-positive boundary: No security event, an allowed request, an origin error, an event attribute that never fires, a different Akamai configuration, or direct-origin behavior does not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: Akamai 差异测试只在 staging property/路径低频执行；发现生产行为发布、真实缓存键、用户事件或源站延迟时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Akamai differential testing runs at low rate on a staging property or path only; stop on production behavior activation, real cache keys, user events, or origin latency.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚临时安全配置，清除测试 CP code/path 缓存，删除源站记录与事件 marker，并确认激活版本恢复后基线一致。
opsecTips.en: Roll back temporary security configuration, purge test CP-code or path caches, delete origin records and event markers, and confirm baselines after the active version is restored.

name.zh: Imperva Cloud WAF 活动文档差异

description.zh: 围绕 data URL、srcdoc、object、embed 与旧式 link import，验证 Imperva Cloud WAF 是否与浏览器活动文档处理保持一致。
description.en: Tests whether Imperva Cloud WAF matches browser handling of active documents delivered through data URLs, srcdoc, object, embed, and legacy link imports.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Imperva Cloud WAF 与浏览器活动文档处理的差异测试：data: 链接、srcdoc、object/embed 与旧式 link import 五条探针。用于确认边缘规则是否理解嵌套文档载体而非只匹配标签名。
overview.en: Covers active-document differentials between Imperva Cloud WAF and browsers: five probes of data: links, srcdoc, object/embed, and legacy link import. Used to confirm whether edge rules understand nested-document carriers rather than matching only outer tag names.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Imperva 策略放行含活动文档的属性，源站不消毒 object、embed、iframe srcdoc 等元素且浏览器支持相应载体；边缘只匹配外层标签名时嵌套文档执行被漏检。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Imperva policy passing attributes carrying active documents while the origin does not sanitize object, embed, or iframe srcdoc elements and browsers support the carriers; nested-document execution escapes detection when the edge matches only outer tag names.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交 5 条 Imperva 活动文档探针；直连放行作为基线，经 Imperva 复测对比拦截差异。先确认目标浏览器对每种载体的支持，再分开记录 WAF 放行、资源加载与嵌套脚本执行三个阶段；已废弃特性（如 link import）按兼容性单独记录。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit five Imperva active-document probes; direct-access pass-through is the baseline, and replaying through Imperva reveals block differences. First confirm target-browser support per carrier, then record three stages separately — WAF pass, resource load, and nested-script execution — noting deprecated features like link import separately for compatibility.

mitigation.zh: 在 Imperva 启用并调优 XSS 防护，但以源站 HTML 消毒移除活动文档元素为主，设置 object-src none、frame-src 与严格脚本策略；修复后三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Enable and tune Imperva XSS protection, but prioritize origin HTML sanitization removing active-document elements, with object-src none, frame-src, and strict script policies; after the fix, the three layers must agree.

title.zh: 固定“Imperva Cloud WAF 活动文档差异”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the Imperva Cloud WAF Active-Document Differential data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“Imperva 策略允许含活动文档的属性通过，源站不消毒 object、embed、iframe srcdoc 等元素，且浏览器支持相应载体”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that Imperva policy accepts attributes containing active documents, the origin does not sanitize object, embed, or iframe srcdoc elements, and the browser supports the carrier, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“Imperva WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Imperva WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“Imperva 事件 ID、最终元素属性、嵌套文档 origin 与唯一执行标记完整记录，已废弃 link import 不应算成功”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the Imperva event ID, final element attribute, nested-document origin, and unique marker are recorded, while obsolete link imports are not counted as success as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“Imperva Cloud WAF 活动文档差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable Imperva Cloud WAF Active-Document Differential check

description.zh: 先确认目标浏览器对每种载体的支持，再向测试策略提交原集合；分开记录 WAF 放行、资源加载与嵌套脚本执行三个阶段；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: confirm browser support for every carrier before submitting the original set to a test policy, and record WAF acceptance, resource loading, and nested script execution as separate stages; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload: XSS

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the Imperva Cloud WAF Active-Document Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 在 Imperva 中启用并调优 XSS 防护，但以源站 HTML 消毒移除活动文档元素为主；同时设置 object-src none、frame-src 和严格脚本策略；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the Imperva event ID, final element attribute, nested-document origin, and unique marker are recorded, while obsolete link imports are not counted as success no longer appears.

review.rationale: Imperva Cloud WAF 活动文档差异保留为 Payload，用于审查“边缘规则是否理解嵌套 HTML 文档载体及其 MIME 和 CSP 约束，还是只匹配外层标签名称”。成立时必须满足证据要求“Imperva 事件 ID、最终元素属性、嵌套文档 origin 与唯一执行标记完整记录，已废弃 link import 不应算成功”，而不是仅依据字符串回显、WAF 放行或普通网络请求。

prerequisites.zh: 测试流量经过目标 Imperva Cloud WAF site/policy，源站会把输入放入允许 iframe、object、embed 或 link 的活动文档上下文。
prerequisites.en: Test traffic passes through the target Imperva Cloud WAF site and policy, and the origin places input into an active-document context that permits iframe, object, embed, or link.

prerequisites.zh: 目标浏览器、MIME、CSP、frame/object 限制和 Imperva/源站日志已记录，data/srcdoc 内容只调用固定 marker。
prerequisites.en: Target browser, MIME, CSP, frame and object restrictions, plus Imperva and origin logs are recorded, and data or srcdoc content calls only a fixed marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是变体通过实际 Imperva policy，浏览器将 data/srcdoc/object/embed 内容作为活动文档处理并执行 marker，执行来源和容器类型明确。 假阳性边界：资源 URL 被请求、文件下载、MIME 或 frame/CSP 阻止、元素在 DOM 中但文档不活动，或只在直连源站执行都不是完整绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a variant to pass the real Imperva policy and the browser to process data, srcdoc, object, or embed content as an active document that executes the marker, with origin and container type identified. False-positive boundary: A requested resource URL, file download, MIME or frame and CSP blocking, a DOM element with an inactive document, or direct-origin-only execution is not a complete bypass.

opsecTips.zh: Imperva 活动文档测试只加载本地空内容；出现顶层导航、插件调用、下载、跨源读取、公共网络请求或生产规则变化时停止。
opsecTips.en: Imperva active-document testing loads local empty content only; stop on top-level navigation, plugin invocation, downloads, cross-origin reads, public network requests, or production-rule changes.

opsecTips.zh: 移除 iframe/object/embed/link 节点与 data/srcdoc 测试页，清理 Imperva/浏览器缓存和日志，恢复 policy 后重载。
opsecTips.en: Remove iframe, object, embed, and link nodes plus data or srcdoc test pages, clear Imperva and browser caches and logs, restore the policy, and reload.

name.zh: Wordfence WAF 动态求值差异

description.zh: 比较 javascript URL、属性拼接、字符串定时器、Function 与 eval 等形式在 WordPress、Wordfence 和浏览器中的处理差异。
description.en: Compares javascript URLs, property concatenation, string timers, Function, and eval across WordPress, Wordfence, and browser processing.

overview.zh: 覆盖 WordPress 环境下 Wordfence WAF 与浏览器的动态求值差异测试：7 条 javascript URL、属性拼接、字符串定时器、Function 与 eval 探针。用于核对规则对动态重建与求值语法的覆盖。
overview.en: Covers dynamic-evaluation differentials between Wordfence WAF and browsers on WordPress: seven probes of javascript URLs, attribute concatenation, string timers, Function, and eval. Used to check rule coverage of dynamic reconstruction and evaluation syntax.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是插件或主题把可控值原样输出，Wordfence 处于学习或例外模式，且页面 CSP 允许内联脚本或 unsafe-eval；规则对动态重建与求值语法的覆盖与浏览器执行结果不一致。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is plugins or themes outputting controllable values verbatim, Wordfence in learning or exception mode, and page CSP allowing inline scripts or unsafe-eval; rule coverage of dynamic reconstruction and evaluation syntax diverges from browser execution.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交 7 条动态求值探针；直连放行作为基线，经 Wordfence 复测对比拦截差异。固定 WordPress、插件和规则版本，逐类比较直接调用与动态重建变体；先确认模板 sink 再评价 WAF 差异，命中记录与模板位置关联。命中规则与放行差异均写入报告，供规则调优参照。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit seven dynamic-evaluation probes; direct-access pass-through is the baseline, and replaying through Wordfence reveals block differences. Pin WordPress, plugin, and rule versions, comparing direct calls versus dynamic-reconstruction variants class by class; confirm the template sink before judging WAF differentials, and correlate hits with template locations. Write both rule hits and pass differentials into the report for tuning reference.

mitigation.zh: 更新 Wordfence 与易受影响插件主题，移除宽泛允许规则；开发使用 esc_html、esc_attr 等上下文匹配的 WordPress 转义 API；修复后边缘动作、源站规范化与浏览器 DOM 三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Update Wordfence and affected plugins/themes, removing broad allow rules; develop with context-matched WordPress escaping APIs such as esc_html and esc_attr; after the fix, edge actions, origin normalization, and browser DOM must agree.

title.zh: 固定“Wordfence WAF 动态求值差异”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the Wordfence WAF Dynamic-Evaluation Differential data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“插件或主题把可控值原样输出，Wordfence 处于学习或例外模式，且页面 CSP 允许内联脚本或 unsafe-eval”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that a plugin or theme emits a controllable value raw, Wordfence is learning or bypassed by an exception, and page CSP permits inline script or unsafe-eval, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“Wordfence WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Wordfence WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“Wordfence 实时流量记录、命中规则、WordPress 模板位置、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记必须相互对应”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only Wordfence live-traffic data, matched rule, WordPress template location, final DOM, and unique marker must correlate as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“Wordfence WAF 动态求值差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable Wordfence WAF Dynamic-Evaluation Differential check

description.zh: 在测试站点固定 WordPress、插件和规则版本，逐类比较直接调用与动态重建变体；先确认模板 sink，再评价 WAF 差异；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: pin WordPress, plugin, and ruleset versions on a test site, compare direct calls with runtime reconstruction by class, and confirm the template sink before assessing WAF differences; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.
